reason: The rule prohibits occupying the driver's seat with the engine running while under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
The rule states a vehicle must have an efficient exhaust silencer that channels exhaust gas through it.
The rule specifies stop lamps must be visible at 30 metres in normal sunlight.
The rule requires a driver to keep their licence or document with them in the vehicle.
The rule states that on a freeway, a driver should keep left and overtake on the right.
The rule requires giving a clear, timely signal of intention, long enough and visible enough to warn others.
The rule explicitly prohibits passing a vehicle that has stopped at a pedestrian crossing.
The rule permits breakdown vehicles working at an accident to use an adjustable spot lamp.
The rule prohibits using a vehicle if its fuel tank, carburettor, or fuel pipes are defective or exposed as a danger.
The rule states that when another vehicle wants to pass, keep left and don't accelerate until it has passed.
No rule directly addresses the implication of a temporary sign indicating an abnormal road situation.
The rule prohibits parking within 1.5 metres of a fire hydrant.
